## Discoveries

[The Stargazer's Terrace](../world/discoveries.md#stargazers-terrace), [The Greywater Cleft](../world/discoveries.md#greywater-cleft), [The Far Canyon Bridge](../world/discoveries.md#the-far-canyon-bridge), [The High Pasture](../world/discoveries.md#the-high-pasture), [The War Camp's Lookout](../world/discoveries.md#war-camp-lookout)

Regional mastery, earned by making discoveries here:

- **Highland Feet** (2 discoveries): 1,000 mesos
- **Friend of the Four Families** (4 discoveries): Skill: [Highland Lungs](../skills/passives.md#highland-lungs)

A taxi from [Ennek](../npcs/ennek_tolmach.md) takes you to any other town for 150 mesos.
